rows.note: Crash canary for the deep-CST class: deep_a.pm/deep_b.pm (12,003-level CSTs, the XML-as-.pm family) are indexed by the same batch startup that answers this ordinary goto-def. Without the pre-walk depth gate the recursive builder walk stack-overflows a 2 MB rayon worker — a fatal abort catch_unwind cannot catch — and the harness reports CRASH. Two copies so at least one lands on a worker stack regardless of scheduling.
